post.description:
The longest border on Earth: 8,891 km and no wall. Canada–USA, Kazakhstan–Russia or Argentina–Chile? Guess first — then watch the line drawn from ocean to ocean.

Sources: International Boundary Commission, CIA World Factbook, Wikipedia (Canada–United States border).
Map data: Natural Earth (public domain). Voice: AI (Kokoro).
